gorgeNights.line: 🌙 Night. The lingering Big Ugly gorges at the treeline — 766 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real

sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Karl, Adaeze, James take up arms and a day's rations (6,114 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
